name: Bumbleride Era Reversible Stroller

clekListed.clekRow: Bumbleride Era — Era Car Seat Adapter – Clek/Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna (MNCE-14)

brake.type: foot-operated one-step parking brake linking both rear wheels (sandal-friendly, lock/unlock from above)
brake.power: One-step foot brake links both rear wheels; fold has auto-lock; certified to AS/NZS 2088 (stricter parking-brake + tether standard). No published brake-force figure or separate wrist tether.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth-ready with no attachment needed (lay-flat + reversible seat); also works with bassinet or infant car seat

safety.standards: ASTM F833 (US 16 CFR 1227); EN 1888 (EU); AS/NZS 2088 (AU/NZ); SOR/85-379 (Canada)
safety.certifications: OEKO-TEX Standard 100 non-toxic recycled fabrics; 5-point harness. Not JPMA-listed.
safety.notes: Cargo basket 21 x 15 x 9 in, 15 lb. Frame alone ~20 lb.

specs.foldType: quick compact fold with auto-lock, self-standing stow
specs.tires: air-filled with inner tubes; 8.5 in front / 12 in rear; all-wheel suspension; front swivel with in-line lock

notes: Bumbleride's reversible-seat full-size city stroller, 27 lb, birth-ready with no attachments. Clek Liing latches via the Era adapter MNCE-14 (adapter-mnce-14), which explicitly lists the Clek Liing. Heavier/pricier than a compact travel stroller; the reversible seat + lay-flat make it a strong everyday city option.
